svg.text: Player names on the tiles and cards SHALL show
in full when they fit and otherwise as first
initial and last name, with the full name as a
tooltip, never cut at any tested width.
The Roster card SHALL list the current roster,
or a retired Manager's final roster, in lineup
order and then bench, IR and taxi, with slot,
status, Player, position and PPG columns.
The PPG chip SHALL be coloured against the
position's replacement level R: dark green
from 1.5R, light green from 1.2R, grey from
0.9R, light red from 0.7R and red below 0.7R.
Each slot SHALL show as a pill in the position
colour, with FLEX split into RB, WR and TE
thirds, BN outlined, IR red and Taxi gold.
Each status SHALL show as a badge, red for the
site's out statuses and grey for Questionable.
The Roster card's footer SHALL show this
The Team History card SHALL have three tabs:
History, Head to Head and Records.
The History tab SHALL show an About sentence,
the League History chart, Honours as years
without counts, and Luck with its numbers
The Head to Head tab SHALL list one row per
opponent, the rival first and the rest by
games played, each with the record, points and
a last result that stays on one line.
The Records tab SHALL show the Manager's
records with their values centred on their
rows, then the history of their Team Names.
A record that is the league's best ever SHALL
carry a gold "#1 All Time" tag.
The League History chart SHALL plot each
season's final finish, 1st at the top, with
the playoff places shaded, a gold trophy for a
title, 💩 for a toilet bowl, a green dot for…
The current season SHALL show as a hollow dot
at the forecast finish, joined to the last
final season by a dashed line.
